source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of June 30, 2026, we had 13,301 full-time employees.

payroll.label: fiscal year 2026 total compensation of the median employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The fiscal year 2026 total compensation of the median employee, based on the compensation of all employees who were employed as of June 30, 2026, other than our CEO, was $252,071.

notes: Employees: year-end full-time count from the FY2026 10-K (temporary employees and consultants are not counted). Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the October 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2026 is used, the same year as the head count. The CEO, Mike Cannon-Brookes, took fiscal 2026 total compensation of $57,337.
